clips.title: The story
paras: Gelihast is a ferocious, twin-blade wielding murloc chieftain residing in the Pool of Ask'ar within Blackfathom Deeps. Surrounded by his Blindlight murlocs, he guards a strange altar in the flooded ruins of the sunken temple.

While most murlocs stay near coastal shallows, Gelihast has claimed a lair deep in the sunken temple of Blackfathom Deeps beneath the Zoram Strand. Wielding twin swords with blinding speed, he cuts down intruders before they can react, and casters who stray into his reach rarely survive.
